paite: Paul, Pathian deihlam a Khrist Jesu sawltak leh i unaupa Timothi in, Korinth a Pathian saptuam omte kiang leh Akhaia gam tengteng a misiangthou omte kiang ah:
heading: Chibai Bukna
english: Paul, an apostle of Christ Jesus through the will of God, and Timothy our brother, to the assembly of God which is at Corinth, with all the saints who are in the whole of Achaia:

paite: Pathian i Pa leh Toupa Jesu Khrist kiang a kipan hehpihna leh khamuanna na kiang uah om hen.
english: Grace to you and peace from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.

paite: I Toupa Jesu Khrist' Pa leh Pathian, zahngaihnate' Pa leh khamuanna tengteng Pathian phat in om hen.
heading: Kipahthu Genna
english: Blessed be the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, the Father of mercies and God of all comfort,

paite: Pathian in koumau hon khamuanna ngei in gimthuakna peuhmah a omte leng ka khamuan sam theihna ding un, ama'n ka gimthuaknate uah ahon khamuan hi.
english: who comforts us in all our affliction, that we may be able to comfort those who are in any affliction, through the comfort with which we ourselves are comforted by God.

paite: Khrist thuaknate tampitak ka tan bang un, Khrist ziak in khamuanna leng tamsem ka tang uhi.
english: For as the sufferings of Christ abound to us, even so our comfort also abounds through Christ.

paite: Himahleh gimthuak a ka om uleh noumau khamuanna ding leh hotdamna ding ahi a; huan khamuan a ka om uleh ka thuak bang uh na thuak chiang ua na theih ua na khamuanna ding uh ahi.
english: But if we are afflicted, it is for your comfort and salvation. If we are comforted, it is for your comfort, which produces in you the patient enduring of the same sufferings which we also suffer.

paite: Huan gimthuakna tang samte na hih bang un, khamuanna tang samte leng na hi uh chih ka theih un, noute a ka lametna uh akip ahi.
english: Our hope for you is steadfast, knowing that, since you are partakers of the sufferings, so you are also of the comfort.

paite: Unaute aw, Asia gam a ka tung ua gimthuakna tung na theih louh uh ka deih kei uhi, huchi a nakpitak a thuakzoh vual louh leh hin leng lamethuai lou khop hial in delhden in ka om uhi.
english: For we don’t desire to have you uninformed, brothers, concerning our affliction which happened to us in Asia: that we were weighed down exceedingly, beyond our power, so much that we despaired even of life.

paite: Ahi, si dia thupukkhum in ka om ua; huai tuh koumau kimuang lou a misite kaithoupa Pathian ka muan zawkna ding uh ahi.
english: Yes, we ourselves have had the sentence of death within ourselves, that we should not trust in ourselves, but in God who raises the dead,

paite: Ama'n huchibang sih lauhuai lak ah hon hunkheta a, ahon hunkhe lellel a, hon hunkhe nawn lai ding ahi, chi in amah ka muang uhi.
english: who delivered us out of so great a death, and does deliver, on whom we have set our hope that he will also still deliver us,

paite: Noute'n leng thumna in na hon panpih ding uh ahi, huchi in tampite thumna dawnna vualzawlna piak a ka om chiang un koute ziak in mi tampi in kipahthu agen ding uhi.
english: you also helping together on our behalf by your supplication; that, for the gift given to us by means of many, thanks may be given by many persons on your behalf.

paite: Koute suanpen hiai ahi, sapilna ah hilou in, Pathian hehpihna ah hi zaw in sianthouna leh Pathian dikna nei in khovel ah mawltak a ka gamta in, nou lam ah ka gamta hoih nawn sem uh chih ka sia-le-pha theihna un hon theisak hi.
heading: Paul Zinna Ding Kikhelna
english: For our boasting is this: the testimony of our conscience that in holiness and sincerity of God, not in fleshly wisdom but in the grace of God, we behaved ourselves in the world, and more abundantly toward you.

paite: Na sim theih uleh na theihtheih ding uh lou ngal thudang himhim na kiang uah ka gelh kei uhi; atawp pha in ka thu uh na theihsiam uh ka lamen lai uhi.
english: For we write no other things to you than what you read or even acknowledge, and I hope you will acknowledge to the end—

paite: Theihsiamna tan na neih tak bang un, i Toupa Jesu ni chiang in, noute ka hon suan theih bang un nou leng koute na hon suang thei sam ding uhi.
english: as also you acknowledged us in part—that we are your boasting, even as you also are ours, in the day of our Lord Jesus.

paite: Huan huai gintakna nei in, na kiang uah hong masa leng ka chi a, kipahna thuah nih na neihtheihna ding un.
english: In this confidence, I was determined to come first to you, that you might have a second benefit,

paite: Noumau tawn kawm in Masidonia gam ah pai zel leng la, Masidonia gam a kipan na kiang uah hong kihei nawn in, Judia gam a ka hohna ding ah noumau hong kha le uchin ka chi ahi.
english: and by you to pass into Macedonia, and again from Macedonia to come to you, and to be sent forward by you on my journey to Judea.

paite: Huchibang ka ngaihtuah lai in ka lungsim kiplouhdan langsak in hia ka hih? Ahihkeileh, "Ahi, chih leh Ahi kei," chi tuaktuak ding in, thilhih ka tup nak pen sadan in hia ka tup?
english: When I therefore planned this, did I show fickleness? Or the things that I plan, do I plan according to the flesh, that with me there should be the “Yes, yes” and the “No, no?”

paite: Himahleh Pathian amuanhuai bang in noumau lam a ka thu uh, Ahi, chih leh Ahi kei, chih ahi kei hi.
english: But as God is faithful, our word toward you was not “Yes and no.”

paite: Akoi abang hi hen aw, Pathian Tapa Jesu Khrist thu, kei Silvanas leh Timothi in na lak ua ka gen un, "Ahi leh Ahi kei,” chih ahi sam kei a, amah ah zaw thil tengteng, "Ahi," chih ahi gige hi.
english: For the Son of God, Jesus Christ, who was preached among you by us—by me, Silvanus, and Timothy—was not “Yes and no,” but in him is “Yes.”

paite: Pathian thuchiamte tengteng in amah ah, "Ahi," chih amu vek hi. Huaiziak in ahi Pathian thupina ding a amah ziak a, "Amen," ka chih uh.
english: For however many are the promises of God, in him is the “Yes.” Therefore also through him is the “Amen”, to the glory of God through us.

paite: Huan Khrist a noumau toh hon hihkippa leh koute hon thaunilhpa, Pathian ahi.
english: Now he who establishes us with you in Christ and anointed us is God,

paite: Amah zaw hon chiamtehpa leh i lungtang a khamna Kha hon pepa leng ahi.
english: who also sealed us and gave us the down payment of the Spirit in our hearts.

paite: Himahleh ka kha tung a theihpih ding in Pathian ka sam ahi, noumau hon hawi ding in ahi Korinth a ka hong tak louh zawk.
english: But I call God for a witness to my soul, that to spare you, I didn’t come to Corinth.

paite: Na ginna uh hon thuneihkhum hilou in, na kipahna ding ua nou toh semkhawm ka hi zaw uhi; ginna a na dinkip ziak un.
english: We don’t control your faith, but are fellow workers with you for your joy. For you stand firm in faith.
